checked: Watch: party moves (PSI, Golkar, PDIP, Gerindra)

events.event: Golkar figures (Secretary-General Sarmuji, Fraksi Golkar's Doli Kurnia) say the DPR can use its right to express an opinion (hak menyatakan pendapat) over VP Gibran after the Supreme Court (MA) ruling that his SMA-equivalence certificate was invalid; Deputy Speaker Dasco says it will be processed formally after recess.
events.key_numbers: Proposal needs at least 25 DPR members · adoption needs plenary with at least two-thirds of members attending · basis Art. 20A(2) UUD 1945 and Art. 79 UU MD3 17/2014 · DPR sessions resume 10 Nov 2026 · MA ruling dated about 30 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Shows how a court ruling on the VP's certificate could turn into a formal DPR process, and how high the bar is.
events.spreading_evidence: Detik front page 9 Nov; PDIP, PKS also reported weighing the same step

events.event: PSI chair Kaesang Pangarep announced that Secretary-General Raja Juli Antoni, Deputy Chair Isyana Bagoes Oka and Dewan Pembina member Giring Ganesha resigned from the party, saying service to the state ranks above party interests.
events.why_it_matters: Three top PSI names, tied to the Prabowo-Gibran cabinet, leave the party that Jokowi's son chairs; reasons are stated only as state duty.
events.spreading_evidence: Detik latest list, Kompas and ANTARA coverage within hours

events.event: Home Affairs Minister Tito Karnavian denied reports that he was barred from travelling abroad in connection with the wiretapping case, calling many rumours hoaxes and saying he has had no role in Polri matters since retiring in 2019.
events.key_numbers: Retired from Polri 2019 · rumour address Widya Chandra 4 vs actual Widya Chandra 1
events.why_it_matters: Rumours are spreading faster than facts in the wiretapping case; officials are denying specific claims.

events.event: Menko Polkam Dudung Abdurachman said wiretapping is only allowed within a criminal investigation and not against a head of state; he joked that about 6,000 people were on the target list, including him.
events.key_numbers: About 6,000 names on the alleged list (stated by Dudung, unverified) · 4 suspects, 3 detained at Mako Brimob, Irjen Slamet Uliandi not detained due to illness
events.why_it_matters: Gives a scale figure and a legal rule for the wiretapping case, though the 6,000 number is an offhand remark.

events.event: PDI-P chair Megawati Soekarnoputri said in a national address that she had asked for Listyo Sigit to be replaced as Kapolri and that she was among those wiretapped; no verification was given.
events.why_it_matters: The biggest party chair now speaks on the case; reactions are splitting along party lines.

events.event: At the Aksi Rakyat Bela Indonesia rally in Jakarta, figures including Bachtiar Nasir, Jimly Asshiddiqie and Said Didu presented five demands tied to the alleged wiretapping, including enforcing court rulings and Art. 33 UUD 1945; a bigger action is planned.
events.key_numbers: 5 demands · next action Sunday 15 Nov 2026 (Hari Pahlawan) · no crowd figure reported
events.why_it_matters: A street movement is forming around the case, with another rally set for 15 Nov.

events.event: Aksi Rakyat Bela Indonesia organisers plan a larger mass action in Jakarta on Hari Pahlawan.
events.why_it_matters: A possible large demonstration in Jakarta in five days.

events.event: DPR recess ends and plenary sessions resume on 10 November, where the Gibran certificate follow-up and the Surveillance Bill are expected to be raised.
events.why_it_matters: First day the DPR can act formally on the two hottest political issues.

events.event: President Prabowo ordered accelerated river normalisation in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra after follow-up floods, in a limited meeting at Istana Merdeka.
events.key_numbers: 137 rivers (31 Aceh, 48 North Sumatra, 58 West Sumatra) · 38 river mouths: 7 done, 11 in progress, 20 not yet · 41 follow-up floods Apr-Oct 2026 · 12 districts hit per BNPB
events.why_it_matters: Residents of flood-prone Sumatra areas get a timeline: 20 of 38 river mouths are still untouched.

events.event: Kejagung has begun examining alleged links between Listyo Sigit and nickel miner Arif Kurniawan in an illegal mining case, per Suara.com.
events.why_it_matters: Possible second legal front against the ex-Kapolri; unconfirmed beyond headline.

events.event: KPK summoned Gerindra DPR member Anwar Sadad over the East Java hibah (grant) corruption case, but he did not appear, citing DPR recess.
events.why_it_matters: A sitting legislator skipping a KPK summons raises the question of whether recess is a valid reason.

Raja Juli is Forestry Minister per a related headline; reason for resignations not stated, not verified
